    SELECT `t0`.`Id`, `t0`.`Jumlah`, `t0`.`ProdukId`, `t0`.`RakId`, `t0`.`SerialNumbers`, `t0`.`TransaksiStokId`, `p`.`Id` AS `Id0`, `p`.`Deskripsi`, `p`.`GudangId`, `p`.`HargaBeli`, `p`.`HargaPerolehan`, `p`.`Kategori`, `p`.`Merek`, `p`.`NamaProduk`, `p`.`PelacakanBarang`, `p`.`RakId` AS `RakId0`, `p`.`Satuan`, `p`.`Sku`, `p`.`Stok`, `p`.`TipeBarang`, `r`.`Id` AS `Id1`, `r`.`Area`, `r`.`BinNo`, `r`.`Deskripsi` AS `Deskripsi0`, `r`.`GudangId` AS `GudangId0`, `r`.`IsActive`, `r`.`KodeLokasi`, `r`.`NamaRak`
    FROM `TransaksiStokDetail` AS `t0`
    INNER JOIN `Produk` AS `p` ON `t0`.`ProdukId` = `p`.`Id`
    INNER JOIN `Rak` AS `r` ON `t0`.`RakId` = `r`.`Id`
) AS `s0` ON `t`.`Id` = `s0`.`TransaksiStokId`
ORDER BY `t`.`TanggalPosting` DESC, `t`.`Id`, `g`.`Id`, `s`.`Id`

INNER JOIN `Gudang` AS `g` ON `t`.`GudangId` = `g`.`Id`
LEFT JOIN `Suppliers` AS `s` ON `t`.`SupplierId` = `s`.`Id`
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT `t0`.`Id`, `t0`.`Jumlah`, `t0`.`ProdukId`, `t0`.`RakId`, `t0`.`SerialNumbers`, `t0`.`TransaksiStokId`, `p`.`Id` AS `Id0`, `p`.`Deskripsi`, `p`.`GudangId`, `p`.`HargaBeli`, `p`.`HargaPerolehan`, `p`.`Kategori`, `p`.`Merek`, `p`.`NamaProduk`, `p`.`PelacakanBarang`, `p`.`RakId` AS `RakId0`, `p`.`Satuan`, `p`.`Sku`, `p`.`Stok`, `p`.`TipeBarang`, `r`.`Id` AS `Id1`, `r`.`Area`, `r`.`BinNo`, `r`.`Deskripsi` AS `Deskripsi0`, `r`.`GudangId` AS `GudangId0`, `r`.`IsActive`, `r`.`KodeLokasi`, `r`.`NamaRak`
    FROM `TransaksiStokDetail` AS `t0`
    INNER JOIN `Produk` AS `p` ON `t0`.`ProdukId` = `p`.`Id`
    INNER JOIN `Rak` AS `r` ON `t0`.`RakId` = `r`.`Id`
) AS `s0` ON `t`.`Id` = `s0`.`TransaksiStokId`
ORDER BY `t`.`TanggalPosting` DESC, `t`.`Id`, `g`.`Id`, `s`.`Id`

    SELECT `t0`.`Id`, `t0`.`Jumlah`, `t0`.`ProdukId`, `t0`.`RakId`, `t0`.`SerialNumbers`, `t0`.`TransaksiStokId`, `p`.`Id` AS `Id0`, `p`.`Deskripsi`, `p`.`GudangId`, `p`.`HargaBeli`, `p`.`HargaPerolehan`, `p`.`Kategori`, `p`.`Merek`, `p`.`NamaProduk`, `p`.`PelacakanBarang`, `p`.`RakId` AS `RakId0`, `p`.`Satuan`, `p`.`Sku`, `p`.`Stok`, `p`.`TipeBarang`, `r`.`Id` AS `Id1`, `r`.`Area`, `r`.`BinNo`, `r`.`Deskripsi` AS `Deskripsi0`, `r`.`GudangId` AS `GudangId0`, `r`.`IsActive`, `r`.`KodeLokasi`, `r`.`NamaRak`
    FROM `TransaksiStokDetail` AS `t0`
    INNER JOIN `Produk` AS `p` ON `t0`.`ProdukId` = `p`.`Id`
    INNER JOIN `Rak` AS `r` ON `t0`.`RakId` = `r`.`Id`
) AS `s0` ON `t`.`Id` = `s0`.`TransaksiStokId`
ORDER BY `t`.`TanggalPosting` DESC, `t`.`Id`, `g`.`Id`, `s`.`Id`

    SELECT `t0`.`Id`, `t0`.`Jumlah`, `t0`.`ProdukId`, `t0`.`RakId`, `t0`.`SerialNumbers`, `t0`.`TransaksiStokId`, `p`.`Id` AS `Id0`, `p`.`Deskripsi`, `p`.`GudangId`, `p`.`HargaBeli`, `p`.`HargaPerolehan`, `p`.`Kategori`, `p`.`Merek`, `p`.`NamaProduk`, `p`.`PelacakanBarang`, `p`.`RakId` AS `RakId0`, `p`.`Satuan`, `p`.`Sku`, `p`.`Stok`, `p`.`TipeBarang`, `r`.`Id` AS `Id1`, `r`.`Area`, `r`.`BinNo`, `r`.`Deskripsi` AS `Deskripsi0`, `r`.`GudangId` AS `GudangId0`, `r`.`IsActive`, `r`.`KodeLokasi`, `r`.`NamaRak`
    FROM `TransaksiStokDetail` AS `t0`
    INNER JOIN `Produk` AS `p` ON `t0`.`ProdukId` = `p`.`Id`
    INNER JOIN `Rak` AS `r` ON `t0`.`RakId` = `r`.`Id`
) AS `s0` ON `t`.`Id` = `s0`.`TransaksiStokId`
ORDER BY `t`.`TanggalPosting` DESC, `t`.`Id`, `g`.`Id`, `s`.`Id`

    SELECT `s0`.`Id`, `s0`.`AlasanSelisih`, `s0`.`Keterangan`, `s0`.`Kondisi`, `s0`.`ProdukId`, `s0`.`ProdukItemId`, `s0`.`SerialNumber`, `s0`.`StockOpnameId`, `s0`.`StokFisik`, `s0`.`StokSistem`, `p`.`Id` AS `Id0`, `p`.`Deskripsi`, `p`.`GudangId`, `p`.`HargaBeli`, `p`.`HargaPerolehan`, `p`.`Kategori`, `p`.`Merek`, `p`.`NamaProduk`, `p`.`PelacakanBarang`, `p`.`RakId`, `p`.`Satuan`, `p`.`Sku`, `p`.`Stok`, `p`.`TipeBarang`, `p0`.`Id` AS `Id1`, `p0`.`CreatedAt`, `p0`.`GudangId` AS `GudangId0`, `p0`.`ProdukId` AS `ProdukId0`, `p0`.`QrCodePath`, `p0`.`RakId` AS `RakId0`, `p0`.`SerialNumber` AS `SerialNumber0`, `p0`.`Status`
    FROM `StockOpnameDetail` AS `s0`
    INNER JOIN `Produk` AS `p` ON `s0`.`ProdukId` = `p`.`Id`
    LEFT JOIN `produk_item` AS `p0` ON `s0`.`ProdukItemId` = `p0`.`Id`
) AS `s2` ON `s1`.`Id` = `s2`.`StockOpnameId`
ORDER BY `s1`.`Id`, `s1`.`Id0`
